I searched for `IssueStatus` as a whole word across the repo. 18 files name the type in an import, an annotation, a type argument, or a `Record` key.

- **Definition:** `src/types/issue.ts` defines the union and also uses it in annotations such as `ISSUE_STATUSES`, `CLOSED_ISSUE_STATUSES`, `Issue.status`, `IssueFilter.status` and `IssueBoardColumn.status`.
- **Two exhaustive `Record` maps:** `src/lib/format.ts` (`STATUS_LABELS`) and `src/components/domain/issue/issue-tone.ts` (`STATUS_TONE`) are typed `Record<IssueStatus, …>`. They won't compile until the new status has an entry.
- **Other type annotations and type arguments:** `src/types/event.ts`, `src/schemas/issue.ts` (including the `_statusParity` check against the zod enum), `src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts`, `src/server/db/seed.ts`, the three pages under `src/app/(dashboard)/…`, `board-model.ts` (`Map<IssueStatus, …>`), `kanban-board.tsx`, `issue-status-select.tsx`, `issue-filter-bar.tsx`, `src/hooks/optimistic-issues-reducer.ts`, `src/hooks/issue-filter-params.ts` and `src/hooks/use-optimistic-issues.ts`.
- **Test file:** `tests/components/board-model.test.ts` imports the type and uses it in an annotation and in casts. I included it because it names the type, but you could leave it out if "source file" means only `src/`.

I left these out:
- `src/types/index.ts` only re-exports with `export * from "./issue"` and never names the type.
- `scripts/manifest-parts/*.ts` and `corpus-manifest.json` contain the name only inside string literals.
- Anything that matches only `defaultIssueStatus`, `changeIssueStatus`, `setIssueStatus`, `ChangeIssueStatusInput` or `IssueStatusSelect`.

ANSWER: src/types/issue.ts, src/types/event.ts, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/projects/[projectSlug]/issues/new/page.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/projects/[projectSlug]/issues/page.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/issues/page.tsx, src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts, src/server/db/seed.ts, src/schemas/issue.ts, src/components/domain/board/board-model.ts, src/components/domain/board/kanban-board.tsx, src/components/domain/issue/issue-tone.ts, src/components/domain/issue/issue-status-select.tsx, src/components/domain/issue/issue-filter-bar.tsx, src/hooks/optimistic-issues-reducer.ts, src/hooks/issue-filter-params.ts, src/hooks/use-optimistic-issues.ts, src/lib/format.ts, tests/components/board-model.test.ts
